rationale: C03 provides a highly specific literal and structural template for the child: both identify Hawaiian land as part of the public lands ceded by the Republic of Hawaii under the July 7, 1898 joint resolution; state that it was reserved for United States military purposes; find that it is no longer needed for those purposes and that restoration is advisable and in the public interest; and then restore a metes-and-bounds-described tract to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii. C25 and C24 use closely related military-reservation restoration machinery, but their recitals are less textually congruent with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a tract of land ... which form[s] a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898, 30 Stat. 750, [was] reserved for military purposes of the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a tract of land ... which forms a part of the public lands ceded and transferred to the United States by the Republic of Hawaii under the joint resolution of annexation of July 7, 1898 (30 Stat. 750), was reserved for military purposes of the United States
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive, nearly verbatim recital language establishing the land's Hawaiian cession history and military reservation status.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS such lands are no longer needed for military purposes and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS such land is no longer needed for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: The operative factual finding and policy justification are virtually identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The following-described tracts of land comprising the Sugar Loaf Military Reservation and right-of-way thereto ... are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described tract of land ... is hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same operative restoration formula immediately before a detailed survey description.
